title: Support Co-pilot

panels.title: Overview  (time range at top right; stats cover the whole range)
Complete (all steps real)
panels.description: Share of processed tickets where EVERY workflow node did real work. Below 100% = some nodes are placeholders (not implemented) or skipped work: results are not trustworthy.

panels.title: Routed to a human
panels.description: Share of DECIDED tickets routed to a person. 'No data' = no real routing decision has been made yet (route node not implemented).

panels.title: p95 time: end to end · worker only
panels.description: End to end = the API receives the request → the ticket is done (masking + queue wait + processing). Worker only = processing in the worker.

panels.title: Possible PII misses
panels.description: Tickets where text still LOOKS like PII after masking (residual check). Alert above 1%.

panels.title: LLM cost
panels.description: Filled once the LLM nodes run (classify, draft)

panels.title: Tickets (live from Postgres, read-only, no ticket text)
Latest tickets (steps completed = real work only; no ticket text)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT number AS "#", ticket_id AS "ticket", status,
  steps_completed || '/' || steps_visited AS "steps completed", CASE WHEN complete THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS "complete", COALESCE(current_step,'') AS "now",
  COALESCE(category,'—') AS category, COALESCE(urgency,'—') AS urgency, COALESCE(decision,'not decided') AS decision, COALESCE(queue,'not decided') AS queue, reasons,
  COALESCE(agent_decision,'open') AS "agent", COALESCE(agent_name,'') AS "by",
  attempts, round(queue_seconds::numeric,2) AS "queue s", round(processing_seconds::numeric,2) AS "processing s",
  created_at AS "received"
FROM tickets_monitoring ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Live from Postgres (view tickets_monitoring, read-only role): never the message, draft or final text. Use the column filters. Open a ticket's full detail with GET /tickets/{number} (agent key).

targets.rawSql: SELECT status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM tickets_monitoring GROUP BY status

panels.title: Agent decisions on co-pilot drafts

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(agent_decision,'open') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status='done' GROUP BY 1

panels.description: sent = draft sent unchanged · edited = agent changed it · manual = handled without the draft · open = not handled yet

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(max(extract(epoch FROM now()-created_at)),0) AS seconds FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status IN ('queued','processing')
SELECT count(*) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status='done' AND agent_decision IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE status='failed'

panels.title: Edit rate (edited / decided)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum((agent_decision='edited')::int)::float / NULLIF(sum((agent_decision IN ('sent','edited'))::int),0),0) AS edit_rate FROM tickets_monitoring

panels.description: Quality metric (PRD §6b): how often agents change the co-pilot's draft before sending. Falling = better drafts.

panels.title: One ticket: status and PII masking (pick Ticket # at the top, or click a # in the table above)

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
SELECT CASE WHEN decision IS NULL THEN 'not decided (processing or failed)' ELSE decision || ' → ' || COALESCE(queue,'—') END AS route FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
SELECT pii_count FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.title: Possible misses (residual)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN pii_residual = '[]' THEN 'none' ELSE pii_residual END AS residual FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.description: Text that still LOOKS like PII after masking (e.g. a mistyped card that fails the checksum). Should be 'none'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pii_ms FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.title: Steps completed

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(implemented::int) || '/' || count(*) AS real_work FROM tickets_steps WHERE number = $ticket

panels.description: How many workflow nodes this ticket went through actually did their job. Placeholder nodes (not implemented yet) only pass the ticket on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(agent_decision || ' by ' || agent_name, 'open (no agent yet)') AS agent FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.title: End to end for this ticket: masking + queue wait + processing = total (one trace: click a trace ID below)
panels.description: Request in → done. Masking = API (PII masking + vault + insert). Queue = waiting for a worker. Processing = the graph in the worker. Tempo shows the same as ONE trace: POST /tickets → ticket.intake → pii_mask → queue.wait → ticket.process → every node.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((intake_seconds * 1000)::numeric) AS "1. API: masking + queued",
  round((queue_seconds * 1000)::numeric) AS "2. waiting in the queue",
  round((processing_seconds * 1000)::numeric) AS "3. worker: the graph",
  round((total_seconds * 1000)::numeric) AS "= TOTAL end to end"
FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.title: Handed to a human: who gets it, why, and the evidence (the message text is only in the agent API, never in Grafana)
panels.description: What the co-pilot hands to the human agent for this ticket: decision, queue, priority, reason codes and evidence (pattern names, model scores). The masked message and the draft are deliberately NOT readable by Grafana (no ticket text in monitoring): open them with GET /tickets/{number} using an agent key (Postman: 2. Agent → 3. Open the ticket).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN decision IS NULL THEN 'not decided yet' ELSE decision END AS "decision",
  COALESCE(queue, '—') AS "queue (who gets it)",
  COALESCE(priority, '—') AS "priority",
  replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(reasons, ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '') AS "why (reason codes)",
  replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(evidence, ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '') AS "evidence (detector names + scores)",
  CASE WHEN agent_decision IS NULL THEN 'waiting for an agent' ELSE agent_decision || ' by ' || agent_name END AS "agent",
  'GET /tickets/' || number || ' (agent key)' AS "the message itself"
FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket

panels.title: How it was masked: one row per detected PII span (never the value)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT field, placeholder, type, recognizer, round(score::numeric, 2) AS score, chars,
  CASE WHEN recognizer = 'MultilingualNameRecognizer' THEN 'model (GLiNER, multilingual)'
       WHEN recognizer IN ('CreditCardRecognizer','IbanRecognizer') THEN 'pattern + checksum'
       WHEN recognizer = 'PhoneRecognizer' THEN 'pattern + phone-number validation'
       WHEN recognizer IN ('DocumentNumberRecognizer','AccountNumberRecognizer') THEN 'pattern + context word'
       ELSE 'pattern' END AS method
FROM tickets_pii_detections WHERE number = $ticket ORDER BY field DESC, placeholder

panels.description: Placeholders replace the values before anything else sees the ticket (LLM, graph, LangSmith, logs). Real values: encrypted vault, 30-day expiry, agent access audited.

defaults.noValue: no PII found in this ticket

panels.title: Timeline

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'received by the API (request in)' AS event, received_at AS at, NULL::numeric AS seconds FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
UNION ALL SELECT 'masked + queued', received_at + make_interval(secs => intake_seconds), round(intake_seconds::numeric, 3) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket
UNION ALL SELECT 'worker started (attempt ' || attempts || ')', started_at, round(queue_seconds::numeric,3) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket AND started_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'workflow finished: ' || steps_completed || '/' || steps_visited || ' steps completed' || CASE WHEN complete THEN '' ELSE ', ' || (steps_visited - steps_completed) || ' placeholders (INCOMPLETE)' END, finished_at, round(processing_seconds::numeric,3) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket AND finished_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'TOTAL end to end (request in → done)', finished_at, round(total_seconds::numeric, 3) FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket AND finished_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'agent: ' || agent_decision || ' by ' || agent_name, decided_at, NULL FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket AND decided_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY at, seconds NULLS FIRST

panels.description: seconds = time since the previous event (queue wait, processing).

panels.title: Risk signals for this ticket (exact patterns first, then the classifier)

targets.rawSql: SELECT kind AS risk, method, strength, round(probability::numeric, 2) AS probability, evidence FROM tickets_risk_signals WHERE number = $ticket ORDER BY method DESC, probability DESC

panels.description: pattern = exact phrase (certain, evidence = pattern name). classifier = bge-m3 + logistic regression: probability, strong (≥0.8, blocks alone) or weak (≥0.5, confirmed with the LLM safety call); evidence = nearest TRAINING example, never the customer's text. Empty = no risk found.

panels.title: Ticket journey: what each step found (green = real work, amber = placeholder, grey = not taken; hover a circle for details)

targets.rawSql:
WITH g(id, title, ord) AS (VALUES
  ('start','POST /tickets (API)',0),('pii_mask','pii_mask (API, BEFORE the graph)',1),('queue','queue (Postgres)',2),
  ('pattern_check','pattern_check (exact phrases, spam)',3),('injection_check','injection_check (gate: patterns + model, before any LLM)',4),('risk_classifier','risk_classifier (bge-m3 + LR, 6 risks)',5),
  ('classify_safety','classify_safety (LLM)',6),('classify_triage','classify_triage (LLM)',6),('policy_gate','policy_gate (hard rules)',7),('retrieve','retrieve (KB search)',8),
  ('template_reply','template_reply (decline / ack)',8),('draft','draft (LLM)',9),('post_check','post_check (numbers, citations)',10),
  ('compose','compose',11),('route','route (who handles it: reasons → queue)',12),('audit','audit',13),('end','done',14)),
t AS (SELECT * FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket),
f(id, finding) AS (VALUES
  ('classify_safety', (SELECT COALESCE(safety_intents, '?') || COALESCE(' · ' || NULLIF(safety_flags, ''), '') || COALESCE(' · $' || round(llm_cost_usd::numeric, 5), '') FROM t)),
  ('pattern_check', COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(CASE kind WHEN 'spam_or_empty' THEN 'spam: ' WHEN 'prompt_injection' THEN 'injection: ' ELSE 'security: ' END || evidence, ', ') FROM tickets_risk_signals WHERE number = $ticket AND method = 'pattern'), 'clean')),
  ('injection_check', (SELECT CASE WHEN injection_detected THEN 'DETECTED' ELSE 'clean' END || ' · guard ' || COALESCE(round(injection_guard_score::numeric, 2)::text, '?') || ' · head ' || COALESCE(round(injection_score::numeric, 2)::text, '?') FROM t)),
  ('risk_classifier', COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(kind || ' ' || round(probability::numeric, 2) || CASE WHEN strength = 'strong' THEN ' (strong)' ELSE ' (weak)' END, ', ' ORDER BY probability DESC) FROM tickets_risk_signals WHERE number = $ticket AND method = 'classifier'), 'no risk')),
  ('route', (SELECT COALESCE(queue, 'not decided') || ' · ' || COALESCE(replace(replace(replace(reasons, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), '') || CASE WHEN priority = 'low' THEN ' · LOW priority' ELSE '' END FROM t))),
s AS (SELECT node, sum(ms) AS ms, count(*) AS runs, bool_and(implemented) AS implemented FROM tickets_steps WHERE number = $ticket GROUP BY node)
SELECT g.id, g.title,
  CASE
    WHEN g.id = 'start' THEN (SELECT ticket_id FROM t)
    WHEN g.id = 'pii_mask' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(round(pii_ms)::text || ' ms · ' || pii_count || ' PII masked', 'no data') FROM t)
    WHEN g.id = 'queue' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(round(queue_seconds::numeric * 1000) || ' ms waiting', 'waiting…') FROM t)
    WHEN g.id = 'end' THEN (SELECT status FROM t)
    WHEN s.node IS NULL THEN 'not taken'
    WHEN NOT s.implemented THEN 'PLACEHOLDER · ' || round(s.ms::numeric, 1) || ' ms'
    WHEN f.finding IS NOT NULL THEN f.finding
    ELSE round(s.ms::numeric, 1) || ' ms' END AS mainstat,
  CASE
    WHEN g.id = 'pii_mask' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN pii_residual = '[]' THEN 'no possible misses' ELSE 'possible miss: ' || pii_residual END FROM t)
    WHEN s.node IS NOT NULL AND NOT s.implemented THEN 'not implemented: did nothing'
    WHEN s.node IS NOT NULL AND f.finding IS NOT NULL THEN round(s.ms::numeric, 1) || ' ms'
    WHEN s.runs > 1 THEN s.runs || ' runs (redraft)' ELSE '' END AS secondarystat,
  CASE
    WHEN g.id IN ('start','pii_mask') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t) THEN 1
    WHEN g.id = 'queue' AND (SELECT started_at IS NOT NULL FROM t) THEN 1
    WHEN g.id = 'end' AND (SELECT status IN ('done','failed') FROM t) THEN 1
    WHEN s.node IS NOT NULL AND s.implemented THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS arc__taken,
  CASE WHEN s.node IS NOT NULL AND NOT s.implemented THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS arc__placeholder,
  CASE WHEN s.node IS NOT NULL THEN f.finding END AS "detail__what it found",
  CASE WHEN s.node IS NOT NULL THEN round(s.ms::numeric, 1) || ' ms' END AS detail__time
FROM g LEFT JOIN s ON s.node = g.id LEFT JOIN f ON f.id = g.id ORDER BY g.ord

WITH e(id, source, target) AS (VALUES
 ('e0','start','pii_mask'),('e0b','pii_mask','queue'),('e1','queue','pattern_check'),('e1d','pattern_check','route'),('e1g','pattern_check','injection_check'),('e1p','pattern_check','risk_classifier'),('e1r','injection_check','risk_classifier'),
 ('e1i','risk_classifier','route'),('e1b','risk_classifier','classify_safety'),('e1c','risk_classifier','classify_triage'),
 ('e2b','classify_safety','policy_gate'),('e2c','classify_triage','policy_gate'),
 ('e3','policy_gate','retrieve'),('e4','policy_gate','template_reply'),('e5','retrieve','draft'),('e6','draft','post_check'),
 ('e7','post_check','draft'),('e8','post_check','compose'),('e9','template_reply','compose'),('e10','compose','route'),
 ('e11','route','audit'),('e12','audit','end')),
p AS (SELECT ord, node FROM tickets_steps WHERE number = $ticket),
t AS (SELECT * FROM tickets_monitoring WHERE number = $ticket),
taken AS (
  SELECT a.node AS source, b.node AS target FROM p a JOIN p b ON b.ord = a.ord + 1
  UNION SELECT e.source, e.target FROM e
    WHERE e.source IN (SELECT node FROM p) AND e.target IN (SELECT node FROM p)
      AND ((e.source = 'risk_classifier' AND e.target <> 'route') OR e.target = 'policy_gate')
  UNION SELECT 'queue', node FROM p WHERE ord = 1
  UNION SELECT node, 'end' FROM p WHERE node = 'audit'
  UNION SELECT 'start', 'pii_mask' FROM t
  UNION SELECT 'pii_mask', 'queue' FROM t)
SELECT e.id, e.source, e.target, CASE WHEN tk.source IS NOT NULL THEN 'taken' ELSE '' END AS mainstat
FROM e LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT source, target FROM taken) tk ON tk.source = e.source AND tk.target = e.target

panels.description: pii_mask runs in the API BEFORE the graph. pattern_check (exact phrases, spam) runs first in the graph; spam goes straight to route (no model, no LLM). risk_classifier, classify_safety and classify_triage run in parallel and join at policy_gate. Green = real work, amber = placeholder, grey = not taken.

panels.title: Steps in order: status and ms

targets.rawSql: SELECT ord AS "#", node, CASE WHEN implemented THEN 'completed' ELSE 'placeholder (did nothing)' END AS status, round(ms::numeric, 1) AS ms FROM tickets_steps WHERE number = $ticket ORDER BY ord
